text:
maria (PM): Quick thread — need to recalibrate RICE for Q3 roadmap. Spreadsheet updated: https://redwood.app/sheets/q3-rice

tyler (Data): I re-ran the impact model; reach dropped ~30% for inference-hosted features after last week's telemetry.

eva (Sales): Heads up: Customer A and B are pushing for private networking improvements. They each represent >$1M ARR.

alex (Eng): Current capacity is tight — 2 SWEs + infra sprint constraints. Can't deliver private vpc + autoscale full scope without depri.

sasha (Design): FYI design estimate for onboarding overhaul is 3w, not 2w.

maria (PM): Proposal: increase 'private-networking' impact due to enterprise demand, but effort also increases. Need a principled re-score.

jonathan (Research): Confidence on impact is ~0.5 for private networking — high ask but high implementation risk.

tyler (Data): Quick calc:
```
private-networking: R=2, I=8, C=6, E=13
RICE = (R * I * C) / E = (2*8*6)/13 ≈ 7.38
```

alex (Eng): That E isn't normalized. If effort is ~20 dev-weeks, our E scale should reflect that. Using raw weeks skews things.

maria (PM): Action: standardize R,I,C on 0-10 and convert effort to 1-10 where 10 = easiest. I'll update the sheet.

planning-bot: New spreadsheet version uploaded by maria: https://redwood.app/sheets/q3-rice?v=3

eva (Sales): Suggest sequencing: ship a small 'vpc-lite' surface first (covers ~60% asks) as a canary — lowers effort.

alex (Eng): 'vpc-lite' estimate = 4 dev-weeks. That is doable this quarter.

tyler (Data): Recalc for vpc-lite: R=2, I=6, C=7, E=4 -> (2*6*7)/4 = 21  -> prioritizes vpc-lite.

sasha (Design): vpc-lite UI needs ~2 design days, good.

maria (PM): Decision: split into 'vpc-lite' (Q3) + 'vpc-full' (Q4). I'll update roadmap + rollout criteria.

alex (Eng): Add fallback: route private requests to hosted variant if private nodes are saturated. Low-risk fallback.

jonathan (Research): Proposed eval metrics: latency delta <= 10ms, TLS handshake success > 99.9%.

maria (PM): Thanks all — I'll push updated RICE scores and timeline by EOD. :thumbsup:

eva (Sales): Please flag top 3 customers to invite into beta.

sasha (Design): :eyes: 

maria (PM): tagging @alex for implementation sync tomorrow.
